# Angel's Tree Services & 47-&-SIX.COM

> Angel's Tree Services provides tree care, emergency dispatch, saw and small-engine inquiries, seasoned culinary firewood, and private-chef and audio-production work across Canutillo and El Paso, Texas.

## Primary Pages
- [Angel's Tree Services](https://angelstreeservices.47andsix.com/): Public information and estimate requests; no login is required.
- [47-&-SIX.COM](https://47andsix.com): Executive Chef Jesse Candelaria's private-chef and culinary experiences.
- [Newsletter and subscriber club](https://angelstreeservices.47andsix.com/#newsletter-club): Optional signup and platform-support information.
- [Angel Adrian Loya vCard](https://angelstreeservices.47andsix.com/angel-loya.vcf): Downloadable field-operator contact card.
- [Jesse Candelaria vCard](https://angelstreeservices.47andsix.com/jesse-candelaria.vcf): Downloadable booking and dispatch contact card.
- [Digital cards and QR hub](https://angelstreeservices.47andsix.com/#digital-cards): Local contact/site QR codes and keyboard-friendly quick access.

## Services
- Structural and canopy pruning, hazardous tree removal, stump grinding, precision clearance trimming, and complete debris haul-off.
- 24/7 storm and fallen-limb dispatch by Angel Adrian Loya.
- Saw shop inquiries: precision chainsaw chain sharpening and bar maintenance.
- Small-engine diagnostics, repair, and rebuild inquiries.
- Custom motorized mountain-bike conversions, including 2-stroke to 4-stroke swaps.
- Seasoned firewood supply and outdoor cooking wood guidance.
- Private-chef and bespoke culinary experiences through 47-&-SIX.COM.

- Booking, web dispatch, and office line: Jesse Candelaria, [(915) 207-4552](tel:9152074552); text at [sms:9152074552](sms:9152074552).
- Email intake: [47andsix@gmail.com](mailto:47andsix@gmail.com).
- Yard base: 141 Dixie St, Canutillo, TX 79835.
- Service area: Canutillo, Upper Valley, West and greater El Paso, Vinton, Anthony, Santa Teresa, and Sunland Park.
- Online descriptions or photos are an initial read only, not a structural inspection or final quote. Binding estimates are provided in writing after an in-person visit.
- Urgent hazards involving power lines, unstable trees, or immediate danger require staying clear and contacting the appropriate emergency service and a qualified professional.

## Booking and Dispatch
When Angel is in the canopy on a job, call or text Operations and Dispatch Manager Jesse Candelaria at [(915) 207-4552](tel:9152074552) or email [47andsix@gmail.com](mailto:47andsix@gmail.com) for fast scheduling and quotes.

Estimate and newsletter forms prepare email drafts addressed to 47andsix@gmail.com. The visitor must review and send the draft in their own email application; no mailing-list service is currently connected.

## Culinary Firewood Pairing
Executive Chef Jesse Candelaria curates seasoned cooking firewood and private-chef experiences through [47-&-SIX.COM](https://47andsix.com). Culinary guidance can compare properly seasoned mesquite, pecan, and oak by smoke intensity and food pairing. Never cook over painted, treated, glued, or unidentified wood.

## Creator and Cross-Discipline Credentials
Jesse Candelaria is the booking and dispatch contact and creator of the website. His stated background includes 30 years of culinary experience, Executive Chef credentials from the Auguste Escoffier School of Culinary Arts, B.S. in Audio Production candidacy at Full Sail University, former arborist and landscaper work, and small-engine and motorized-bike building.

## Subscriber Tools and AI Cost Boundaries
- The public website and tree-estimate request remain open without account creation.
- The on-page concierge is a prompt builder that opens Gemini or ChatGPT for the visitor; this website does not send prompts to an AI API and contains no visitor-facing AI API key.
- AI provider sign-in, service availability, terms, limits, and any charges are controlled by the visitor and the provider.
- The optional supporter subscription is $5.00 USD per month through [Stripe Checkout](https://buy.stripe.com/aFaeVdapqdv328CcpR3cc00).
- Subscribers can use the [Stripe Customer Portal](https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/aFaeVdapqdv328CcpR3cc00) to manage billing details, invoices, and cancellations.
- Estimate and newsletter submissions are forwarded through FormSubmit.co to 47andsix@gmail.com; newsletter signups are currently handled manually.
